audit_member_text: [L169-L173] (LOW/nonfinite-comparison) The difference threshold has no finite-value check, so NaN differences fail the greater-than comparison and are not even printed as discrepancies.

adversarial.rationale: The size guard protects only the ndarray reduction from empty input, and neither the test nor libxbeach.get_array/get_arrays filters nonfinite values.
